entries.게이트 이후의 세계, 바스티온에서 시작되는 방어전: A world after the Gates. The last stand begins at Bastion.
entries.정체불명의 게이트가 열린 뒤, 인류는 이계화된 위험에 맞서 거점과 자원을: After mysterious Gates tore open, humanity fights to hold its strongholds and resources against otherworldly threats.
entries.나중에 실제 이미지 파일을 넣으면 배경 콘셉트, 세력, 사건 이미지를 바: Once real image files are added, this area will showcase setting concepts, factions and key events.
entries.게이트 이후 재편된 전장 지도: The battlefield map, redrawn after the Gates
entries.바스티온, 외곽 지역, 게이트 오염 구역을 한눈에 보여주는 핵심 이미지: Key image slot showing Bastion, the Outskirts and the Gate-tainted zones at a glance.
The core base of operations the player must defend.
A danger zone where the laws of reality have broken down.
Image slot depicting Gate technology and its ethical conflicts.
entries.각 정보 카드는 이미지와 설명을 함께 보여주며, 버튼과 검색창으로 빠르게: Each card pairs an image with a description. Use the buttons and search box to filter quickly.
entries.각 사건마다 대표 이미지 자리를 두어 로딩 화면이나 세계관 설명 화면처럼: Each event has its own key image slot, styled like a loading screen or lore screen.
Mysterious passages open across the world, and the old order begins to crumble.
A stronghold rises to gather survivors and defensive forces.
entries.게이트를 통제하려는 세력과 이용하려는 세력, 생존하려는 세력이 충돌합니다: Those who would control the Gates, those who would exploit them and those who just want to survive collide.
Basic terms used throughout the world lore pages.
An unstable passage linking the Otherworld and reality.
A phenomenon in which the environment and living things are transformed by a Gate's influence.
People who gained special powers or abilities after the Gate incident.
Humanity's key defensive stronghold against the threat.
Meet the characters of Bastion and their relationships.
entries.게이트 이후의 세계에서 명령을 내리고, 거래를 이어가고, 금지된 기술을: Profiles of those who give orders, strike deals and wield forbidden technology in the world after the Gates.
entries.소속 버튼을 누르면 해당 세력의 인물만 볼 수 있고, 캐릭터 카드를 누르: Tap a faction button to show only its members, or tap a character card to view their full profile.
The commander in charge of Bastion's outer defense line.
If the line falls, the city falls with it.
entries.현재는 임시 관계 구조입니다. 캐릭터가 확정되면 우호, 감시, 적대, 거: These relationships are provisional. Once the characters are finalized, they can be broken down into allies, watchers, rivals and trading partners.
entries.공식적으로는 통제와 감시 관계이지만, 현장에서는 보급과 정보 거래가 이루: Officially a relationship of control and surveillance, but in the field they trade supplies and intel.
entries.방어 기술 협력 관계이지만, 비윤리적 실험과 기술 독점 문제로 갈등합니다: Partners in defense technology, but at odds over unethical experiments and Arcana's tech monopoly.
As both citizens and military assets, the Awakened are protected and conscripted at the same time.
A field commander who oversees Bastion's outer defense line.
entries.게이트 오더 소속 지휘관으로, 시민 보호와 방어선 유지를 최우선으로 생각: A Gate Order commander whose top priorities are protecting civilians and holding the line. She respects the chain of command, but often clashes with the brass who treat casualties in the field as mere numbers.
entries.방어 지휘, 지원 명령, 위기 대응: Defense command, support orders, crisis response
A Frontier guide who blazes trails through the tainted zones.
entries.바스티온 바깥의 폐허와 이계화 지형을 누구보다 잘 아는 개척자입니다. 게: A pioneer who knows the ruins and otherworlded terrain beyond Bastion better than anyone. He resents Gate Order control, but knows that if the city falls, the Outskirts fall too.
Sometimes the safest road is the one that's not on the map.
An Arcana researcher studying Arc-Cells and Otherworld byproducts.
entries.아르카나 연구소에서 게이트 에너지와 방어 장비를 연구합니다. 기술이 인류: Researches Gate energy and defensive gear at the Arcana lab. She believes technology can save humanity, but grows increasingly uneasy about the lab's secret experiments.
entries.장비 분석, 에너지 보조, 약점 파악: Gear analysis, energy support, weakness detection
Technology can be the answer. It's the people using it who are the problem.
An Awakened who gained a special sensing ability after the Gate incident.
entries.게이트 발생 이후 이계 에너지에 반응하는 능력을 얻었습니다. 보호 대상이: After the Gates appeared, she gained the ability to sense Otherworld energy. She rebels against being labeled both a ward and a combat asset, and fights to keep the right to choose for herself.
I'm not a weapon. But I still have people to protect.
A seasoned scavenger who salvages Gate byproducts and scrapped gear.
entries.버려진 전장에서 쓸 수 있는 것은 무엇이든 회수합니다. 암시장과도 연결되: Salvages anything usable from abandoned battlefields. He has black market ties, but holds to a line: keeping the Frontier's people fed.
Even scrap is an asset if it keeps you alive.
A key Arcana figure leading the Gate weaponization project.
entries.인류가 살아남으려면 금지된 기술도 통제해야 한다고 주장합니다. 바스티온: Argues that humanity must master even forbidden technology to survive. He is a great help to Bastion's defense, but shows a dangerous tendency to treat people as tools.
entries.실험 장비 지원, 특수 무기 제공, 위험한 거래: Experimental gear, special weapons, dangerous deals
Ethics can wait until we've survived.
An overview of Bastion's factions and the balance of power between strongholds.
entries.각 세력은 목적, 강점, 약점, 플레이어와의 관계를 기준으로 정리했습니다: Each faction is profiled by its goals, strengths, weaknesses and relationship with the player.
A military administration that contains the Gate Disaster and holds Bastion's defense line. It keeps the city safe in the name of order and control, but its heavy-handed policies toward the Awakened and Outskirts survivors breed conflict.
entries.게이트 봉쇄, 방어선 유지, 바스티온 질서 보존: Seal the Gates, hold the line, preserve order in Bastion
entries.정규 병력, 방어 시설, 지휘 체계: Regular troops, fortifications, chain of command
entries.과도한 통제, 각성자 징발, 프론티어 감시: Excessive control, conscription of the Awakened, surveillance of the Frontier
entries.바스티온 외곽을 이동하며 폐허, 오염지대, 게이트 주변에서 자원을 회수하: A band of pioneers roaming Bastion's Outskirts, salvaging resources from ruins, tainted zones and the areas around the Gates. They live outside the official order, but know the field and its danger zones better than anyone.
entries.생존, 거래, 외곽 루트 개척: Survival, trade, opening routes through the Outskirts
entries.탐색 능력, 비공식 정보망, 이동 거점: Scouting skills, an informal intel network, mobile bases
entries.밀수 의심, 게이트 오더의 통제, 암시장 연결: Suspected smuggling, Gate Order control, black market ties
entries.게이트와 이계 기술을 연구하고 상용화하려는 기업형 세력입니다. 방어 기술: A corporate faction that researches and commercializes Gate and Otherworld technology. It advances defensive tech, but its forbidden experiments and monopoly drive the darker conflicts of the world.
entries.이계 기술 확보, Arc-Cell 개발, 전장 장비 판매: Acquire Otherworld tech, develop Arc-Cells, sell battlefield gear
entries.연구 시설, 실험 장비, 비밀 자금: Research facilities, experimental gear, secret funding
entries.윤리 위반, 각성자 실험, 게이트 부산물 독점: Ethics violations, experiments on the Awakened, monopoly on Gate byproducts
entries.바스티온 내부의 자원 분배, 시민 통제, 방어 예산을 결정하는 정치 세력: The political body that decides resource allocation, civilian control and the defense budget inside Bastion. It never sets foot on the battlefield, yet it sets the terms and limits of every operation.
entries.도시 생존, 자원 통제, 민심 관리: Keep the city alive, control resources, manage public sentiment
entries.행정 권한, 보급 승인권, 여론 통제: Administrative authority, supply approval, control of public opinion
entries.내부 파벌, 예산 삭감, 작전 개입: Internal factions, budget cuts, meddling in operations
entries.각성자를 단순 전력이나 실험체가 아닌 시민으로 인정받게 만들려는 느슨한: A loose alliance fighting to have the Awakened recognized as citizens, not mere assets or test subjects. Less a public political force than a protection network and resistance group.
entries.각성자 보호, 강제 징발 반대, 정보 공유: Protect the Awakened, oppose forced conscription, share intel
entries.특수 능력, 은밀한 네트워크, 시민 지지: Special abilities, a covert network, public support
entries.게이트 오더 감시, 아르카나 실험, 내부 급진파: Gate Order surveillance, Arcana experiments, internal radicals
entries.현실과 이계를 연결하는 불안정한 통로입니다. Project D의 재난,: An unstable passage connecting reality and the Otherworld. It is the root cause of the disasters, battles and resource conflicts in Project D.
entries.게이트의 영향으로 지형, 생물, 물질이 기존 세계의 법칙에서 벗어나 변질: A phenomenon in which terrain, creatures and matter are warped beyond the laws of the old world by a Gate's influence.
entries.게이트 사태 이후 특별한 능력을 지니게 된 인물입니다. 보호 대상이면서: People who gained special abilities after the Gate incident. They can be treated both as people to protect and as military assets.
Humanity's key stronghold for defense and survival amid the Gate threat. A natural hub for the player's operations.
entries.게이트 재난을 통제하고 인류 방어선을 유지하려는 조직입니다. 질서와 통제: An organization that seeks to contain the Gate Disaster and hold humanity's defense line. A faction that puts order and control above all.
entries.위험 지역을 이동하며 생존과 거래를 이어가는 개척자 집단입니다. 거점 밖: A band of pioneers who survive and trade while roaming the danger zones. They offer a window into the world beyond the stronghold.
entries.게이트와 이계 기술을 연구하고 이용하려는 기업형 세력입니다. 기술 발전과: A corporate faction that researches and exploits Gate and Otherworld technology, torn between progress and unethical experimentation.
entries.방어, 자원, 각성자 활용 문제를 두고 바스티온 내부 세력들이 충돌하는: Factions inside Bastion clash over defense, resources and how to use the Awakened.
entries.각성자를 보호해야 할 시민으로 볼지, 게이트 대응을 위한 전략 자산으로: Conflict erupts over whether the Awakened are citizens to protect or strategic assets against the Gates.
A shadow economy trading in Gate byproducts, forbidden tech and illegal gear. Perfect material for side quests.
